description: List live file offers in this Space (id, filename, bytes, hash). Metadata only — filenames stay plaintext on sealed Spaces (the server can read names). Bytes stay off this result. Peek bytes without consuming: GET /v1/files/{id}/copy (write-scope; sender allowed). get_file consumes. Read-only: does not advance the unread cursor and does not consume the offer. REST: GET /v1/files. Idempotent.
name: list_files
title: List files
